Source contracts: startmanual.sh

startmanual.sh

Shell · Tier B

Serve the standalone manual from the repository environment.

Usage

Start independently when startup.sh is not already serving the manual port.

Inputs

--host, --port and --reload override AOR_MANUAL_HOST/PORT/RELOAD; defaults to

Side effects

Selects the root .venv and starts Uvicorn with the manual app factory; loads authored/generated references and its search index.

Cleanup

exec transfers the shell to Uvicorn; the caller or parent startup.sh owns termination.

@see src/manual/app.py
